code:
text = '句一内容。句二内容。句三内容。句四内容。句五内容。句六内容。句七内容。句八内容。'

print('== 策略A: 固定长度12 无重叠 ==')
size = 12
pos = 0
while pos < len(text):
    end = min(pos + size, len(text))
    print('chunk start=%d end=%d len=%d' % (pos, end, end - pos))
    pos = end

print('== 策略B: 固定长度12 重叠4 ==')
size, overlap = 12, 4
pos = 0
prev_end = 0
first = True
while pos < len(text):
    end = min(pos + size, len(text))
    ov = (prev_end - pos) if not first else 0
    print('chunk start=%d end=%d len=%d overlap=%d' % (pos, end, end - pos, ov))
    if end == len(text):
        break
    prev_end = end
    pos = end - overlap
    first = False

print('== 策略C: 按句边界 每块最多3句 ==')
sents = [s + '。' for s in text.split('。') if s]
chunk = ''
cnt = 0
for s in sents:
    if cnt == 3:
        print('chunk len=%d sents=3' % len(chunk))
        chunk = ''
        cnt = 0
    chunk += s
    cnt += 1
if chunk:
    print('chunk len=%d sents=%d' % (len(chunk), cnt))
